# Retail CoD 1.1d dedicated server: linkTo on a tag that lives on an attached
# model. map mp_carentan, gametype dm (served as probe_linkattach), no client.
#   COD_LNXDED_HOME=<absolute, no '+'> PORT=31861 SECS=20 \
#       tools/run_probe.sh client-probes/probe_linkattach mp_carentan
# probe_linkattach.gsc spawns a script_model (entity 170) wearing
# playerbody_german_wehrmacht with weapon_thompson attached on
# "tag_weapon_right", links k1 (171) to the thompson's "tag_flash" with zero
# offsets and k2 (172) to the same tag keeping its pose, then moves and turns
# the model, detaches the thompson, attaches it again with weapon_mp40 (which
# has a tag_flash of its own) after it, detaches all, links to the thompson's
# root bone "tag_weapon", and ends on a link to "tag_flash" with nothing
# attached, whose fatal is the last measurement. docs/research/cod11-movers.md
# section 16, "A tag on an attached model", is what it measured.
# The PROBE lines out of games_mp.log, the console's error block as PROBE_ERR:
#   PROBE m <phase> <time> <m origin> <m angles> <k1 origin> <k1 angles> <k2 origin> <k2 angles>
